gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Loud stencil cuts, with wide bridges between letters, make Snowburst One hard to miss. Noto Sans Kharoshthi counters with curves that never close back on themselves and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Expressive stencil letters from Snowburst One make a statement, with wide bridges between letters and a sprung-paper-clip opening. Noto Sans Khmer does the quiet work, small letters standing proud.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-khudaw: Snowburst One brings stencil boldness, wide bridges between every letter. Noto Sans Khudawadi sits beside it with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, and little height difference between capitals and body.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kr: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One loves a wide bridge between letters. Noto Sans KR does the steadier job, keeping generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lao: Stencil bridges split up every Snowburst One letter, giving it an unmistakable cut-sheet look. Noto Sans Lao brings an x-height pushed well above the usual, with mouths that stay open on c, e, and a.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha reads friendly and approachable, its curves keeping a wide opening. Line after line it settles into a comfortable rhythm, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals, while Snowburst One handles the stencil drama.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Approachable letters with gaping curves and big-bodied lowercase make Noto Sans Limbu friendly under Snowburst One's loud stencil heading. Page after page, it should go down smoothly, curves gaping wide.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Expressive to the last letter, Snowburst One is cut like a stencil sheet with wide bridges between them. Noto Sans Lydian handles the quiet part, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase.
